description: Log daily screen time by app or category and see daily totals plus a 7-day bar summary — all saved in your browser.

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage. Your entries stay on your device and are restored when you return.
Yes — pick a category like Social, Work, Entertainment, Games, News or Other for each entry.

howto: Pick the date (defaults to today) and a category.
Enter minutes and press Log time.
See the day's total and per-category breakdown.
